title: R. Iʿtiqādiyya ('Statement of Creed')

date.basis: MK: 'presumably' written around the time of Nafsat al-Maṣdūr II (ca. 832-35/1429-32) because it mentions the R. Iʿtiqādāt; that reasoning gives only a lower bound. The only witness, MS Majlis 10196 f. 171b, is undated.

occasion: A statement of creed accompanying the second apology, offered to defend his wide learning against charges at odds with Sunnism.
manuscript: 1 copy: MS Majlis 10196 f. 171b (undated); apparently survives only there. Folio 171b lies inside the range given for the Iʿtiqādāt (ff. 165b-72a).
summary: A very brief statement of creed in the form of a letter, justifying his wide learning in youth by the hadith 'learn even sorcery' and saying that Sufi formulations he has carried over do not touch creed.
